correctness.rationale: The dimension-free upper bound and two-coordinate equality construction are correct. Coordinatewise application of the \(\ell_4^2\) operator norm gives \(P^4+Q^4\le2m^4\), and the fourth-power mean gives the claimed average bound. Choosing \(x=(u,v)\), \(y=(v,-u)\) on two coordinates from an operator-norm extremizer makes both transformed norms equal to \(m\). The substitution \(r=u^2-v^2\), \(q=2uv\) is surjective onto \(\mathbb R^2\), and an independent symbolic generalized-eigenvalue calculation reproduced the characteristic polynomial and discriminant \(\alpha^2\beta^2(\alpha^2+2\beta^2)(2\alpha^2+\beta^2)\).
